Location: Bishop s Stortford, Hertfordshire
Salary: £27,000 £30,000 per annum, depending on experience
Contract: Full-time, permanent Office-based Five days per week

About the role

Are you an ambitious, organised and forward-thinking individual with a keen eye for detail Do you enjoy working with numbers, supporting a busy finance team and contributing to the success of a growing business
Daniel Robinson & Sons is looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Accounts Assistant / Administrator to join our finance team at our Bishop s Stortford office.

Reporting directly to the Finance Manager, you'll play an important role in supporting the day-to-day running of the Accounts Department, ensuring financial transactions are processed accurately and efficiently.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous accounts experience who is looking to develop their skills and make a valuable contribution to a growing business.

You'll need a good understanding of financial processes, strong IT skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team.

Key responsibilities
- Accounts Receivable: Prepare and issue sales invoices, ensuring they are processed accurately and on time.

- General Accounts Administration: Provide day-to-day administrative support to the finance team and assist with other finance-related duties as required.

About you

To be successful in this role, you'll be organised, proactive and comfortable working in a busy environment where accuracy and attention to detail are essential.

Essential skills and experience:
- AAT Level 2 qualification.
- Previous and recent experience in a similar Accounts Assistant or Accounts Administrator role.
- Strong IT and computer skills, with the ability to work confidently with financial data and spreadsheets.
- A good understanding of accounting processes, including sales and purchase ledger activities and reconciliations.
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- A professional approach to handling confidential and sensitive financial information.
- The ability to manage your workload, prioritise tasks and meet deadlines.
- A positive, flexible and team-oriented attitude, with the ability to work independently when required.

What we offer
- Competitive salary of £27,000 £30,000 per annum, depending on experience.
- The opportunity to join a busy and growing business.
- A varied role with exposure to a broad range of finance and accounting activities.
- The opportunity to contribute to the continued success and development of the business.

How to apply

If you have the skills and experience we're looking for and would like to join our team, we'd love to hear from you.

Please submit your up-to-date CV along with a covering letter explaining why you are suitable for the role.

No agencies, please.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Bookkeeper

Location: Stevenage - Office Based
Salary: £35,000-£40,000 per annum, plus an attractive benefits package and pension
Contract: Permanent, Full-Time
Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am-5:30pm
Reporting to: Managing Director

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced, organised and proactive Bookkeeper to join a growing UK business based in Stevenage.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on finance professional to take ownership of the day-to-day bookkeeping and financial administration of an SME. Working closely with the Managing Director and liaising with the external accountant, you will play an important role in maintaining accurate financial records, ensuring timely reconciliations and providing reliable financial information to support business decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Day-to-Day Bookkeeping
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date accounting records using QuickBooks , ensuring all transactions are supported by appropriate invoices, receipts and documentation.
- Process supplier invoices, expenses, customer invoices and credit notes accurately.
- Apply appropriate account codes and VAT treatments, referring complex or unfamiliar matters to the external accountant where necessary.
- Review bank feeds, match transactions and ensure duplicate entries are avoided.

Banking and Payments
- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards and other relevant accounts regularly, completing formal month-end reconciliations.
- Investigate discrepancies, resolve errors and maintain a clear audit trail.
- Prepare supplier payment schedules and payment batches for approval.
- Follow established financial controls, including expenditure approval procedures and verification of supplier bank details.

Sales and Purchase Ledgers
- Maintain accurate customer and supplier accounts and balances.
- Allocate customer receipts and supplier payments, reconcile supplier statements and resolve account queries.
- Monitor overdue customer accounts and undertake appropriate credit-control activities.
- Prepare clear aged debtor and creditor reports.

Month-End and Financial Reporting
- Complete the agreed month-end checklist and investigate unusual or unexplained balances.
- Produce routine profit and loss, balance sheet and cash-position reports.
- Highlight significant financial movements, overdue debts and upcoming payment requirements to management.
- Prepare supporting schedules and financial information for the external accountant.
- Assist with year-end preparation and respond to accountant queries.

VAT and Financial Administration
- Prepare VAT returns and supporting reconciliations for review and submission, where authorised.
- Maintain organised digital financial records and promptly identify missing documentation.
- Ensure financial information is accurate, complete and readily accessible.
- Identify opportunities to improve bookkeeping processes, reporting and financial controls.

Payroll

Payroll responsibilities will depend on the final scope of the role. These may include preparing payroll inputs for an external provider, checking approved payroll changes, reviewing payroll outputs, maintaining confidential records and coordinating payroll-related reporting and payments.

title: Bookkeeper - Award Winning Practice, Bishop's Stortford
description:
Bookkeeper - Independent Practice

Bishop's Stortford

TPF Recruitment have partnered with an award winning accountancy practice in Bishop's Stortford to recruit an experienced Bookkeeper into their successful, growing team.

This Bookkeeper position plays a vital role in ensuring the financial accuracy and compliance of a growing independent accounting practice, serving small to medium-sized businesses across diverse industries.

As Bookkeeper, you will be central to maintaining reliable financial records, delivering timely reporting and supporting clients in meeting their statutory obligations under HMRC regulations and UK accounting standards. With a focus on precision, professionalism and client-centric service, you will leverage cloud-based accounting platforms to streamline operations and enhance efficiency.

The ideal candidate will be a detail-oriented professional with a minimum 2 years' experience who thrives in a dynamic, client-focused environment.

Responsibilities:

- Prepare monthly and quarterly financial statements, including profit and loss accounts, balance sheets and cash flow statements.
- Support clients with VAT returns, PAYE, and other statutory filings in full compliance with HMRC requirements.
- Proactively collect, verify, and organize financial documentation from clients to ensure completeness and accuracy.
- Assist in the preparation of year-end accounts and provide coordinated support during external audits.
- Establish and maintain secure, organized digital and physical filing systems to ensure data compliance and easy retrieval.
- Identify and resolve discrepancies in financial data promptly, escalating complex issues to senior accountants when necessary.
- Communicate clearly and consistently with clients and internal teams regarding financial status, reporting timelines, and compliance deadlines.
- Stay current with changes in UK tax legislation, accounting standards and regulatory updates to ensure ongoing compliance.

Requirements

Bookkeeper
- Must live a commutable distance from Bishop's Stortford
- This role is a full-time, office-based position.
- Minimum 2 years' professional bookkeeping experience within a reputable accounting or financial services environment.
- Strong knowledge of UK accounting standards, HMRC regulations, and statutory compliance (VAT, PAYE, Corporation Tax).
- Proficiency in cloud-based accounting platforms such as Xero, QuickBooks, or Sage.

Benefits

Bookkeeper
- Competitive salary package of between £28,000 and £38,000 dependent on experience level.
- Study support with expert mentoring from an experienced leadership team.
- Long term career progression opportunity with an award winning accountancy practice.
- Regular team events.
- Client networking events and supporting of local sporting clubs.
- Central Bishop's Stortford location with parking available.
- Company pension.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant (Accounts and Billing) Location: Watford (Hybrid: 3 days in office, 2 days working from home)
Contract Type: Temp to Perm
Availability: Immediately available candidates only
Salary Range: £32,000 to £35,000 per annum

Role Purpose
To support the day-to-day operation of the finance function through accurate transaction processing, reconciliations, customer billing, and collections. The role maintains accurate financial records, resolves routine queries, and supports the wider finance team, managing routine work independently with appropriate review and escalation of complex matters.

Key Responsibilities
- Process supplier invoices, checking that the required approvals are in place and applying accurate nominal ledger coding.
- Process employee expenses, checking coding and uploading transactions into the finance system.
- Process credit card expenses, ensuring accurate nominal coding and application of established VAT treatments.
- Record bank receipts and payments in Sage, complete bank reconciliations, and investigate or escalate outstanding differences.
- Maintain subscription billing and collection records, ensuring that direct debit mandates in GoCardless and payment arrangements in Stripe align with invoices in the relevant billing systems, including Stripe, Naviga, and Xero.
- Monitor failed customer payments and follow the agreed process to resolve collection issues.
- Allocate customer receipts from the bank account to invoices in Naviga and investigate unallocated cash.
- Reconcile billing, payment-provider, and accounting records to bank receipts, investigating missing allocations, duplicate entries, and unexplained differences.
- Manage the finance inbox, responding to and resolving routine queries and referring matters to the appropriate colleague where required.
- Prepare national statistics survey responses, coordinating review of unusual definitions or matters requiring judgement.
- Maintain clear supporting records and follow up unresolved items to completion.
- Assist the wider finance team with duties and ad hoc projects consistent with the scope of the role.

Scope and Accountability
Manage routine processing, reconciliations, and queries independently within agreed procedures and deadlines. Escalate complex accounting or VAT matters and issues requiring approval to the appropriate finance colleague.
Person Specification
Essential Experience, Knowledge, and Skills
- Relevant practical finance experience covering purchase ledger, expenses, customer receipts, and bank reconciliations, with the ability to manage routine work with normal supervision.
- Sound working knowledge of bookkeeping, including double-entry principles and the relationship between invoices, credit notes, payments, receipts, and ledger balances.
- Experience investigating reconciliation differences, payment discrepancies, and unallocated receipts, with appropriate follow-up and escalation.
- Ability to apply established nominal and VAT coding and recognise transactions requiring technical review.
- Confidence comparing and reconciling data across accounting, billing, and payment systems.
- Practical Excel skills, including filters, lookups, SUMIFS, and duplicate checks.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to resolve queries with suppliers, customers, and colleagues.
- Strong attention to detail, organisation, and ability to manage recurring deadlines and competing priorities.
- Sound judgement about when to resolve an issue independently and when to seek approval or technical support.

Qualifications
- AAT Level 3 completed or in progress, or equivalent practical knowledge and experience.

Desirable Experience and Skills
- Experience in a subscription or recurring billing environment.
- Experience using GoCardless or Stripe for collections and reconciliation.
- Experience using Sage or Xero, and familiarity with Naviga.
- Experience working across multiple finance or billing systems and following up failed payments.
- Experience completing Office for National Statistics surveys or similar business returns.
- Ability to use Excel pivot tables.
